cd /workspace/t && cat > stress.py <<'PYEOF'
import sys, json, time, subprocess
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/t')

def timed(label, raw):
    t=time.time()
    p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-B','/workspace/project/main.py'],input=raw,capture_output=True)
    dt=time.time()-t
    try:
        out=json.loads(p.stdout.decode())
    except Exception:
        out={'raw':p.stdout[:200].decode('utf8','replace'),'err':p.stderr.decode()[:500]}
    print('%-34s %6.2fs rc=%d %s' % (label, dt, p.returncode, json.dumps(out)[:220]))
    return out

def doc(**kw):
    d={"seed":"s","definitions":[],"timeout_ms":10,"cases":[],"events":[],"channels":[]}
    d.update(kw); return json.dumps(d).encode()

# 1. huge repeated body in a capture
d = doc(definitions=[["BIG", "b'x'*1000000000"]],
        channels=[{"name":"c","parts":[{"case":None,"data":"GET /x HTTP/1.1\r\nContent-Length: 1000000000\r\n\r\n{{BIG}}"}]}])
timed('huge length body', d)

# 2. huge part with no CRLF -> syntax quickly
d = doc(definitions=[["BIG", "b'x'*1000000000"]],
        channels=[{"name":"c","parts":[{"case":None,"data":"{{BIG}}"}]}])
timed('huge bare part', d)

# 3. 8192 definition chain
defs=[["A0","b'0123456789'"]]
for i in range(1,8192):
    defs.append(["A%d"%i, "A%d + b'x'"%(i-1)])
d = doc(definitions=defs, cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"data","data_to_transfered":"{{A8191[100:120]}}","End_Stream":True}],"expect":{"method":"GET","target":"/","host":"h"}}])
timed('8192 definition chain', d)

# 4. many frames
frames=[{"Type":"headers","data_to_transfered":[[":method","GET"],[":path","/x"]],"End_Stream":False} for _ in range(2000)]
cases=[{"name":"c%d"%i,"frames":frames,"expect":{"method":"GET","target":"/x","host":"h"}} for i in range(20)]
d = doc(cases=cases)
timed('20 cases x 2000 frames', d)

# 5. 20000 requests in a channel
req = "GET /x HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h.example\r\n\r\n"
d = doc(cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"headers","data_to_transfered":[[":method","GET"]],"End_Stream":True}],"expect":{"method":"GET","target":"/x","host":"h.example"}}],
        channels=[{"name":"c","parts":[{"case":"a","data":req*20000}]}])
timed('20000 requests', d)

# 6. 40000 chunk lines
body = "1\r\na\r\n"*39999 + "0\r\n\r\n"
d = doc(cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"headers","data_to_transfered":[[":method","GET"]],"End_Stream":True}],"expect":{"method":"GET","target":"/x","host":"h.example"}}],
        channels=[{"name":"c","parts":[{"case":"a","data":"POST /x HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h.example\r\nTransfer-Encoding: chunked\r\n\r\n"+body}]}])
timed('40000 chunk lines', d)

# 7. 50000 events + parts
events=[{"at":i,"kind":"data","stream":0,"data":"x","end":False} for i in range(50000)]
d = doc(cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[],"expect":{"method":"GET","target":"/","host":"h"}}], events=events)
timed('50000 events', d)
PYEOF
python3 stress.py
